WITH RECURSIVE d(id) AS (
  SELECT fl.src FROM fact_links fl
  JOIN sources s ON (s.id = fl.dst OR s.uri = fl.dst)
  WHERE fl.kind LIKE 'DERIV%' AND instr(s.uri, '02_api_style_guide_v1') > 0
  UNION
  SELECT fl.dst FROM fact_links fl
  JOIN sources s ON (s.id = fl.src OR s.uri = fl.src)
  WHERE fl.kind LIKE 'DERIV%' AND instr(s.uri, '02_api_style_guide_v1') > 0
  UNION
  SELECT fl.src FROM fact_links fl
  JOIN d ON fl.dst = d.id
  WHERE fl.kind LIKE 'DERIV%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT dec.text
FROM decisions dec
JOIN decision_facts df ON df.decision_id = dec.id
WHERE df.fact_id IN (SELECT id FROM d)
